transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ConversalQ support, how can I help you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Your platform leaked our customer data. I have proof. My lawyer is going to hear about this if this isn't resolved today.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I take this matter extremely seriously. I want to assure you we have a dedicated security and legal response team. I'm escalating this right now to our Data Protection Officer. Can you share what evidence you have so I can pass it on accurately?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: We received emails from our customers saying they got phishing emails that referenced our ConversalQ conversations. It could only have come from your system.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for that detail — I've captured it. I want to be transparent: I'm not in a position to confirm or deny a breach at this stage, but I'm flagging this as a critical security incident right now. Your company name and contact will be passed directly to our DPO and legal team.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: How quickly will someone contact me?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A member of our security response team will contact you within 2 hours at the number you're calling from. Your incident reference is SEC-20260514-0091. This is treated as a P1 critical incident.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: SEC-20260514-0091. I've also emailed this to the address on your account. Is there a direct email I should also use for the security team's response?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Noted — legal@acmecorp.com added to the incident. You will hear from us within 2 hours. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
